spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Best, excellent.
m. (-रः)
1 A boon, a blessing, &c.
2 A son-in-law.
3 Surrounding, encompassing.
4 A catamite.
n. (-रं)
Saffron.
f. (-र)
Asparagus racemosus.
f. (-रा)
The three myrobalans.
n. or ind. (-रं)
Slightly desired, preferable.
E.
बॄ to select, &c. अप् aff; the root is more usually written वॄ, and the derivative वर, q. v.

mf. (-टः-टी)
A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
f. (-टी)
A whore.
E.
बर्ब्ब to go, अट aff.

f. (-णा)
A blue fly.
E.
बर्ब्ब to go, aff. युच् or derived from वर् imitative sound, and बण or वण् to sound, aff. अच्, बर्ब्बण or वर्ब्बण.

m. (-रः)
A blockhead, a fool.
E.
वर्ब्ब to go, अरच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (बर्हते)
1 To be pre-eminent or excellent; (also वर्ह, but less usually.)
2 To speak or tell.
3 To kill or hurt.
4 To cover.
5 To remember.
6 To spread.
7 To give. (In these senses it is more usually वर्ह.)
r. 10th cl. (बर्हयति)
To hurt or kill; also वर्ह.

mn. (-र्हः-र्हं)
1 A peacock's tail.
2 A leaf.
3 Dependants, retinue.
E.
बर्ह to spread, &c. aff. अच्; this word and the corresponding forms are more usually derived from वृह to increase, &c. and are written with the semivowel: see वर्ह, वर्हिस्, &c.

A shoot of the mango.
3 The son of an unchaste woman, a bastard.
E.
बर्ब्बटी a whore, and र aff.
